🇷🇺🇨🇳 Russia trains China's Airborne Forces for a landing on Taiwan — British analytical center RUSI*

According to the article, citing an 800-page document obtained from Russian servers by the hacker group Black Moon, Russia agreed in 2023 to supply the PLA with a battalion set of airborne equipment, weapons, and vehicles, as well as to conduct a full training cycle for operators and technical personnel to use it. The delivery will include:

• 37 units of BMD-4M with 30mm and 100mm guns;
• 11 armored personnel carriers BTR-MD "Rakushka";
• 11 airborne self-propelled anti-tank guns 2S25M "Sprut-SDM1" with 125mm guns;
• Several command-observation vehicles "Rubin" and command vehicles KShM-E.

It is also claimed that Russia will allegedly transfer technologies to China that will allow it to expand production of similar weapons and military equipment through localization and modernization, and all supplied equipment must be equipped with Chinese communication and control systems.

It is asserted that Russia should also train a battalion of Chinese paratroopers — mechanic-drivers at the "Kurganmashzavod" base, and crews of command-observation vehicles and "Spruts" in Penza, at JSC "NPP Rubin". After that, collective training of the PLA Airborne Forces battalion will take place on Chinese territory, where Russian instructors will teach parachuting, fire control, and maneuvering as part of a unit.

In addition to the above, China will receive from Russia mobile reconnaissance and artillery fire control posts 1V119 "Reostat" and UAV complexes "Orlan-10", and a technical maintenance and repair center for Russian equipment will be established in China.

The ability to parachute armored vehicles onto golf courses or other open and hard ground areas near Taiwanese ports and airfields will allow airborne troops to significantly increase their combat power and create a threat of capturing these facilities to clear the way for the landing of subsequent forces, the report states.

Furthermore, the existing agreement allegedly provides for the transfer of special-purpose parachute systems "Dalnolyot", designed for parachuting a person from an altitude of up to 10,000 meters over a distance of up to 80 km. Russian special forces train their Chinese counterparts to covertly infiltrate the territories of the Philippines and Taiwan, and Russian instructors will teach Chinese pilots, members of the crews, parachute landing of equipment.

* an undesirable analytical organization on the territory of Russia.

milinfolive
